newsitem.title: USA: GM sets seat belt contract with Takata.
newsitem.headline: GM sets seat belt contract with Takata.

text.p: Takata Inc said Monday it received a multi-year contract to provide seatbelt systems to eight General Motors Corp vehicle platforms around the world.
Takata Inc is the North American subsidiary of Takata Corp, a Japanese maker of seatbelts, air bags and interior trim products.
Takata said the contract is its largest to date from GM, but it did not disclose any details. A representative from Takata was not available for comment.
Takata Inc President Daniel Hess said in a statement the combined platforms will make Takata one of GM's largest seatbelt suppliers.
